comment: The mode is a parameter, MODE_PARAM, but it has no widget on the panel, so it can only be set from the panel menu and no click can reach it for help. Its default of 1 is comparator mode. Both modes pass the result through a one-pole lowpass at 19000Hz. In delay mode a pitch change of a semitone or more starts a 0.05 second crossfade onto a second delay line, and smaller changes glide the delay time instead, which is what the README describes as tracking legato and vibrato. The README says the PWM rate knob is unused when PWM CV is connected; the code still advances the LFO, it simply discards its value, so the effect is as the README says. Comparator mode also multiplies the pulse by an envelope taken from the rectified input, so silence at the input gives silence rather than a DC offset.
